Mutant.name: Mutant
Mutant.description:
🦎 Your Quirk is your body: permanent heteromorph features such as animal traits, gills, wings, scales, horns, extra limbs or unusual senses.

🌱 Your features never switch off, and Eraser Head's Erasure cannot touch them.
⚠️ People always see them, and some judge you for them.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Tsuyu Asui (Frog), Mezo Shoji (Dupli-Arms), Hound Dog (Dog).

📈 Grants: Endurance +1, Perception +5, Quirk Mobility +5, Quirk Analysis +5, Health +10
⚡ Starting technique: Special Move Training
Mutant.traitNarrativeEffects: Built into the body: permanent features (animal traits, gills, wings, scales, horns, extra limbs, odd skin or senses), never off; always shown unless clothing hides them. Living with them costs no Quirk Strain; techniques pushing them do. Erasure: Shota Aizawa (Eraser Head) cannot erase Mutant features; he uses his capture weapon and close combat. Natural function (gripping tail, gills, flight, tough hide) works while he looks; anything sent from the body (flame, venom, sound blast) is Emitter and stops while his look holds. Law: having the features is legal; public use as a weapon or tool follows normal Quirk rules. Society: open prejudice (stares, seat-changing, refused rentals and jobs, slurs), worse in rural towns that call heteromorphs cursed; gear and clothes need custom work; villain recruiters court outcasts; some heroes and fans welcome them. Conflicts: one Quirk Type; Quirkless wins; No Quirk family: no Quirk or features, just bonuses.
